observations: Photo 0 shows two headlight assemblies with clear lenses and chrome housings, one lying on top of the other, with visible damage to the housing and mounting points.
Photo 1 shows four taillight assemblies: two with pinkish-red lenses and two with red lenses, all with clear turn signal sections; some show cracks and scratches.
Photo 2 is a wider shot showing all six lights together — two headlights and four taillights — arranged on a paved surface against a textured wall.
All lights appear to be used, with visible wear, dirt, and some physical damage (cracks, dents, broken mounting tabs).
No brand or model markings are visible on any of the lights in any photo.
The seller claims 'good condition', but the photos show clear signs of wear and damage.

identity.kind: used car head and tail lights

claims.claim: Used head and tail lights in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, and 2 show visible cracks, scratches, and damaged housings, contradicting 'good condition'.

risks.risk: Lights may not function due to internal damage or broken wiring harnesses
risks.proof: Close-up of the internal bulb sockets and wiring connections, or a video showing the lights powered on.

risks.risk: Lights may not fit the buyer's vehicle due to lack of model identification
risks.proof: Photo showing the back of the lights with mounting points and any part numbers or vehicle compatibility labels.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used lights, lower value

risks.risk: Lights may have hidden cracks or stress points not visible in current photos
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges and surfaces under bright light, or a video rotating the lights.
risks.if_unproven: priced with assumption of more damage than visible

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the back of each light showing mounting points and any part numbers or vehicle compatibility labels.
Close-up photos of the internal bulb sockets and wiring connections.
Video showing the lights powered on to verify functionality.
Photos of the lights under bright light to check for hidden cracks or stress points.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as used car head and tail lights. The seller's claim of 'good condition' is contradicted by visible damage. The item can be priced at its worst case (damaged, non-functional, generic fit) based on current photos. Hidden risks like non-functionality and fitment are noted, but the item is still priceable.
